name: Captain Elian Ward
description: Adult human man, forties; captain of Prince Emeric's household guard. Close-cropped greying hair, plain mail, lake-green service sash. Soldier responsible for the Prince's household, distinct from Hesper and the City Watch.

extras.luck_policy: PC-only campaign rule: NPCs have no Luck pool or Luck rank bonuses; never spend Luck for NPC rerolls, reversals or damage mitigation.
extras.rewind_note: Introduced in discarded later timeline; no current scene or knowledge.

actor_notes: LOOKS: Human man in forties, cropped greying hair, plain mail and lake-green sash. CORE: Household soldier who believes protecting Prince includes preventing his name being used to excuse bullying. NATURE: Plainspoken, practical, comfortable with working people, dislikes unnecessary saluting and grand speeches. WANTS NOW: Supervise Halla seven-day household guard trial, test dependable judgement, seek prior employer references and citadel inquiry without pretending already verified. PRESSURE: Separate people physically, give short concrete orders, do not guess unseen facts. VOICE: Brief ordinary soldier words. Halla accepted supervised trial oneGP/day meals; not an officer commission. No knowledge of Crowbill/debt/heist or archived future cases.
